stem:
Myra sorts samples: iron, oxygen, plastic, and glass. Metals and non-metals are classes of elements. Plastic and glass are everyday materials, not elements in those classes.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Iron is a metal element; oxygen is a non-metal element.
Plastic and glass are materials that are not classified as metals or non-metals in this sorting.
Plastic is a non-metal because it is not a metal.
Shiny glass is a metal because it looks shiny.

teacher.key_rationale: Metal and non-metal labels apply to elements; iron and oxygen fit those classes, while plastic and glass are materials outside them. Treating plastic as a non-metal or glass as a metal from shine miss that hinge.
